key_insight: Gen-PINNs combines physics-informed learning with adversarial training to reduce PINN failures such as spectral bias, loss imbalance, and optimizer stagnation in difficult PDEs.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a more accurate and stable data-free solver for nonlinear flow and wave-type PDEs with sharp gradients, shocks, or high-frequency structure.
method: Generator minimizes dynamically weighted physics, boundary, and initial-condition losses.
Discriminators assess residual features against an ideal zero-residual target.
Fourier-based representation and spectral diagnostics improve high-frequency resolution and error tracking.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports testing on Burgers, Allen-Cahn, and Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equations, with improved accuracy and convergence over standard PINNs on sharp-front, stiff, and higher-order problems.
watch_item: The added adversarial and dynamic-weighting components may increase training complexity and tuning burden compared with standard PINNs.
paper_title: Gen-PINNs: Generative Adversarial Physics Informed Neural Networks for solving partial differential equations
